title: A check whose judgment lane did not run must say so loudly
description: Found running a whole publication's drafts through Humanus: the papyrus-newsroom Python environment installs humanus without the jev extra, so every judgment policy was silently skipped (lanes.classifier.status 'unavailable') and the run looked like a clean result. Fix both ends: the CLI and agent tooling install humanus[jev] (or papyrus-newsroom gains an extra that does), and papyrus editorial check / check-version / check-drafts print a warning and exit non-zero (or mark the run incomplete) when a pack has judgment policies but the classifier lane did not run, with the reason (missing extra, missing TYPESAFE_API_KEY, deadline). Stored EditorialCheckRuns record incomplete lanes so the board does not show them as clean.
